rationale: Roberts is best positioned to hold a unanimous coalition with a narrow as-applied rule allowing neutral, objective administration while forbidding Wisconsin’s qualitative “religious enough” inquiry. Thomas/Alito/Gorsuch are the most likely to add church-autonomy/anti-entanglement concurrences, while Sotomayor/Kagan/Jackson may write separately to emphasize administrability and equal-treatment concerns without expanding the holding.
